VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The self-report alone is insufficient to verify that the acceptance criteria have been met. While the agent claims all 72 tests pass and describes a plausible root cause and fix, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or other artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly require that "all 72 tests pass," which demands verifiable proof, not assertion. A self-report is the weakest form of evidence and cannot substitute for objective test results or code review artifacts.
